decisions.statement: An initiative is named by the slug the initiative declares.
A name that is no initiative is refused.
A call naming other than one word is refused.
Taking the page away is left to the mechanical change taking away a file.
The intents the initiative held go with the initiative's page.
The pages naming the initiative are read before the page goes.
Every page still naming the initiative is named in what a run says.
A run says under which property each of those pages names the initiative.
A run naming an initiative a seat is assigned is not refused for that seat.
A run says the index files those names until a refresh runs.
A run says the commit that run landed.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.
A change that refused is a fault of the data.
Nothing here asks Alan to confirm.
No check runs over what a run lands.
A run that wrote before it threw says in its refusal what that run had written.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.

definition: the command taking one initiative's page away with the files beside that page
